metadata.description: Claude Code skills for writing readable code, refactoring, designing interfaces, building APIs, and securing web apps.

plugins.name: readable-code
plugins.description: Write and review code for readability — naming, guard clauses, dead code, comments, null returns, symmetry.

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Restructure code — defer abstraction, extract methods by level, replace primitives with objects, turn loops into pipelines.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Visual design rules for app UI — design systems, hierarchy, spacing, type, color, depth, empty states.

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Design and review HTTP APIs — resources and endpoints, status codes, RFC 9457 error bodies, relationship loading, pagination, versioning.

plugins.name: queued-jobs
plugins.description: Design reliable background jobs — idempotency, payload limits, retries and backoff, concurrency and rate limiting, deployment restarts.

plugins.name: laravel-audit
plugins.description: Audit an existing Laravel codebase — authorisation gaps, unvalidated input, raw queries, exposed routes, fake facades, N+1 queries, dead code.

plugins.name: eloquent-queries
plugins.description: Decide where Eloquent query logic lives — tappable scopes, attribute scopes, query objects, scoped global scopes, shared eager loads.

plugins.name: web-security
plugins.description: Secure a web app at the edge — CSP and security headers, subresource integrity, cookies, CORS, the proxy trust boundary, and bot protection.

plugins.name: request-handling
plugins.description: Supplements Laravel Boost's best-practices skill — invokable vs grouped controllers, signals a resource route has drifted, middleware as an authorisation location, job/action split.

plugins.name: laravel-packages
plugins.description: Build and maintain a Laravel package — service provider wiring, optional peer dependencies, errors strangers can act on, Octane-safe state, driver extension points, version matrices and upgrade guides.
